metrics.justification: No corruption charge or conviction of record. A review of court and anti-corruption records to the source date found no personal matter against the minister. Recorded as the subject's own factual status only.

metrics.justification: Handling of repeated KLIA Aerotrain failures in the Transport remit: suspended the end-of-life service on 1 Mar 2023, delivered a China-built replacement (resumed 1 Jul 2025), and on 29 Oct 2025 called renewed breakdowns 'unacceptable', directing APAD enforcement against operator MAHB. Documented on-record responses to a discrete recurring crisis, mixed and not-yet-durable outcomes (anchor 2).

citation.title: Service now halted, Loke says KLIA aerotrains at end of lifespan and will take two years to replace

metrics.justification: Structural reforms delivered and operative within remit: ended physical road-tax and licence display from 10 Feb 2023; replaced ad-hoc summons-discount campaigns with a standardised 'pay early, pay less' structure operative 1 Jan 2026 (Cabinet decision 17 Oct 2025). Some announced measures (school-zone 30km/h gazette) still pending at the cut-off; delivered-with-some-pending (anchor 3).

citation.title: Road tax and driving licence go digital from today, no physical display required for private vehicles

metrics.justification: Drove revival of an independent Malaysian Transport Safety Board (multi-modal accident investigation): Cabinet in-principle agreement announced 5 Feb 2026, bill targeted for tabling June 2026. Documented institution-building, but the body was not enacted or operative by the 1 Jun 2026 cut-off (anchor 2).

citation.title: Transport Ministry to present Malaysian Transport Safety Board plan to Cabinet soon, says Anthony Loke

metrics.justification: Shifted from a firm 'no summons discounts' position (restated 12 Dec 2023) to a permanent discount structure announced Oct 2025, giving a public rationale (perceived unfairness to motorists who pay promptly) but without squarely owning the earlier stance as reversed. Reversal with partial explanation (anchor 2).
